newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 28.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 28.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to major shipping on Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
Pacific port Puerto Penasco was reopened to tourism and fishing boats after temporarily shut over the weekend.
A new tropical storm at 540 miles (864 km) south-southwest of Manzanillo, Colima state sparked expected thunder storms in Colima, Jalisco and Nayarit.
Thunder storms also forecast for Oaxaca and Chiapas states.
Clear skies along the Gulf of Mexico. Rains along the coast of Colombia, Panama, Costa Rica and Nicaragua.
